task.ques: Find the GitHub Skill section and how many courses are under the 'First day on GitHub' heading.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: GitHub Skills has 3 courses under “First day on GitHub”: Introduction to GitHub, Communicate using Markdown, and GitHub Pages.
Source: https://learn.github.com/skills (accessed October 28, 2026), reached through GitHub → Resources → GitHub Skills.
Evidence: final.png shows the heading and all three course cards, followed by the next section, “First week on GitHub.”
